entities.name: Slobodan Novak
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ante Slobodan Novak was a Croatian writer and novelist. He is best known for his novel Gold, Frankincense and Myrrh (1968), often listed as one of the best Croatian novels of the 20th century.
